subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
1.  
What is the percentage of excess production to standard production? 
(A)  
20% 
(B)  
15% 
(C)  
35% 
(D)  
45%
suggested_answer: (C) 35% Working Notes Standard production for 28 days = 22,400 tonnes Standard production Per day = 22,400 ÷ 28 = 800 tonnes For 25 days: Standard = 800 × 25 = 20,000 tonnes Actual production = 27,000 tonnes Excess production = 27,000 − 20,000 = 7,000 tonnes % Excess Production = 7,000 20,000 × 100 = 35%
